--- call_named_yield_multi.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
CALL my_tvf(p) YIELD Id AS tvf_Id, score
RETURN p.Id AS person_Id, tvf_Id, score

--- AST
&ast.GQLGraphQuery{
  GraphClause: &ast.GQLGraphClause{
    PropertyGraphName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 6,
          NameEnd: 14,
          Name:    "FinGraph",
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Query: &ast.GQLMultiLinearQueryStatement{
    Statements: []ast.GQLLinearQueryStatement{
      &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
        Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{
          &ast.GQLMatch{
            Optional: -1,
            Match:    15,
            Pattern:  &ast.GQLGraphPattern{
              Paths: []*ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                &ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                  Path: &ast.GQLPathPattern{
                    Terms: []*ast.GQLPathTerm{
                      &ast.GQLPathTerm{
                        Primary: &ast.GQLNodePattern{
                          Lparen:  21,
                          Rparen:  30,
                          Pattern: &ast.GQLElementPatternFiller{
                            EmptyPos: -1,
                            Variable: &ast.Ident{
                              NamePos: 22,
                              NameEnd: 23,
                              Name:    "p",
                            },
                            Label: &ast.GQLLabelFilter{
                              Is:    -1,
                              Colon: 23,
                              Expr:  &ast.GQLNameLabel{
                                Name: &ast.Ident{
                                  NamePos: 24,
                                  NameEnd: 30,
                                  Name:    "Person",
                                },
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.GQLTVFCall{
            Optional: -1,
            Call:     32,
            Per:      -1,
            TVF:      &ast.TVFCallExpr{
              Rparen: 45,
              Name:   &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 37,
                    NameEnd: 43,
                    Name:    "my_tvf",
                  },
                },
              },
              Args: []ast.TVFArg{
                &ast.ExprArg{
                  Expr: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 44,
                    NameEnd: 45,
                    Name:    "p",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            Yield: &ast.GQLCallYield{
              Yield: 47,
              Items: []*ast.GQLCallYieldItem{
                &ast.GQLCallYieldItem{
                  Name: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 53,
                    NameEnd: 55,
                    Name:    "Id",
                  },
                  Alias: &ast.AsAlias{
                    As:    56,
                    Alias: &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 59,
                      NameEnd: 65,
                      Name:    "tvf_Id",
                    },
                  },
                },
                &ast.GQLCallYieldItem{
                  Name: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 67,
                    NameEnd: 72,
                    Name:    "score",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.GQLReturn{
            Return: 73,
            Items:  []*ast.GQLReturnItem{
              &ast.GQLReturnItem{
                Star: -1,
                Expr: &ast.Path{
                  Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 80,
                      NameEnd: 81,
                      Name:    "p",
                    },
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 82,
                      NameEnd: 84,
                      Name:    "Id",
                    },
                  },
                },
                Alias: &ast.AsAlias{
                  As:    85,
                  Alias: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 88,
                    NameEnd: 97,
                    Name:    "person_Id",
                  },
                },
              },
              &ast.GQLReturnItem{
                Star: -1,
                Expr: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 99,
                  NameEnd: 105,
                  Name:    "tvf_Id",
                },
              },
              &ast.GQLReturnItem{
                Star: -1,
                Expr: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 107,
                  NameEnd: 112,
                  Name:    "score",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) CALL my_tvf(p) YIELD Id AS tvf_Id, score RETURN p.Id AS person_Id, tvf_Id, score
